sermon.title: Love that never lets go
sermon.speaker: Pastor
sermon.notes: A sample sermon to try the Sermon page with: each part has its notes and verses. Change it, or start your own.

sections.name: Opening
sections.notes: Have you ever been afraid of being let go: by a job, a friend, a family? Paul writes to people who knew trouble, and tells them what can never be taken away.

sections.name: God is for us
sections.notes: If God is for us, who can be against us? The proof is the cross: he did not spare his own Son. A God who gave that much will not hold back the rest.

sections.name: Nothing can separate us
sections.notes: Paul lists everything we fear: trouble, hardship, danger, death, powers, the future. None of it can separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus.

sections.name: Living it this week
sections.notes: Name one fear you carry into this week. Each morning, read verses 38 and 39 aloud and put that fear in the list.

games.title: Love that never lets go: were you listening?
games.description: Five questions on the sample sermon, Romans 8.

questions.prompt: Which letter was today's reading from?
